title: Staff Software Engineer (Marketing Platforms)
description: Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role The Marketing Platforms area, inside our Growth Platforms BU , is responsible for enabling Nubank’s growth engine across owned and paid channels. This includes our public websites (BR, MX, CO and future markets), the Audience Manager platform (how we build, govern and activate audiences for campaigns and experiments), and Campaign Manager / orchestration capabilities that connect messages, audiences and channels into coherent customer journeys at scale. As a Staff Software Engineer – Marketing Platforms , you will be a senior technical leader working across this ecosystem: defining architecture and technical direction, ensuring that Audience Manager, Website Platform and Campaign Manager evolve as a cohesive platform, and directly influencing how Nubank acquires, engages and retains customers across countries. Responsibilities Designing and evolving large-scale, data-intensive marketing platforms, in domains such as martech, experimentation, audience/identity and web platforms, operating across multiple channels and markets. Working end-to-end across the Marketing Platforms stack, partnering with Audience Manager, Website Platform and Campaign Manager squads to define technical direction, shape roadmaps and ensure these platforms work together as a cohesive ecosystem. Translating growth and brand strategy into platform architecture, turning audience, campaign and website needs into clear architectural choices and explicit trade-offs with a long‑term view. Providing strong technical leadership: setting architectural direction, leading design reviews, evolving engineering standards and mentoring engineers and tech leads across multiple squads. Helping teams design systems that are observable, debuggable and experimentation‑friendly, supporting data‑driven decision making in how we run campaigns and optimise journeys. Navigating complex stakeholder landscapes, collaborating with Product, Data, Design, Marketing and other platform teams to align priorities, manage dependencies and keep interfaces between systems healthy over time. Operating in high‑visibility, cross‑impact areas, where platform decisions directly affect Nubank’s growth, brand presence and audience activation across BR, MX, CO and future geos. Framing ambiguous problems into clear options, and driving alignment through well‑structured communication (technical docs, RFCs, design sessions and presentations). Required Solid experience as a Staff‑level engineer designing and evolving large‑scale, data‑intensive platforms, ideally in marketing technology, experimentation, audience/identity or web platforms. Ability to work end‑to‑end across a multi‑product stack, partnering with several squads to make sure platforms interoperate as a coherent ecosystem. Proven track record connecting product strategy and platform design, turning growth and brand objectives into concrete architectural choices for audiences, campaign orchestration and website capabilities. Strong technical leadership skills: setting architectural direction, driving design reviews, evolving engineering standards and mentoring senior engineers and tech leaders. Experience with experimentation and data‑driven decision making, and with designing systems that are observable, instrumented and easy to reason about. Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, collaborating with Product, Data, Design, Marketing and other platform teams to align priorities and manage dependencies. Comfort operating in high‑visibility, cross‑impact domains, where platform decisions have direct effect on growth and brand outcomes. High tolerance for ambiguity, with the ability to frame complex problems into clear options and drive alignment through structured written and verbal communication. Nice to have Background in growth, martech or CRM platforms. Experience in multi‑country or multi‑brand environments. Previous work on customer data platforms, journey orchestration or experimentation platforms. Location for this opportunity Brazil – Hybrid hubs: São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro, or Belo Horizonte (aligned with Nubank’s official office locations). Work Model for this Role Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit Our Benefits – Brazil (Employee, Hybrid) Chance of earning equity at Nubank Food / Meal Card (Vale‑Refeição and/or Vale‑Alimentação) Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte) NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program Life Insurance Medical Plan Dental Plan NuLanguage – Language Course Program Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses Extended Parental Leave Daycare Allowance Parental Consultancy Work‑from‑home Allowance Gym Partnerships 30 days of paid vacation Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable Join us If you want to shape the platforms that power Nubank’s growth engine — from how we build audiences to how we orchestrate campaigns and run our public websites — we’d love to hear from you. Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers. #J-18808-Ljbffr

O cargo existe para assegurar que a engenharia projetada em escritório se converta, em campo, em equipamento montado e mantido com confiabilidade, protegendo a operação do cliente e a reputação técnica da Natec junto ao mercado de óleo gás e naval. Missão do Cargo Liderar e executar, em campo, as atividades de montagem e manutenção mecânica e hidráulica dos equipamentos especiais da Natec — guindastes e A-Frames subsea, HPUs, cilindros e unidades hidráulicas — garantindo entregas técnicas seguras, dentro do prazo e em conformidade com normas, em operações onshore e embarcadas. O cargo existe para assegurar que a engenharia projetada em escritório se converta, em campo, em equipamento montado e mantido com confiabilidade, protegendo a operação do cliente e a reputação técnica da Natec junto ao mercado de óleo gás e naval. Atuar diretamente na execução de montagens e manutenções sempre que a operação exigir, servindo de referência técnica para a equipe. Assegurar o cumprimento de normas de segurança do trabalho (NR-35, procedimentos offshore/HSE do cliente) e dos procedimentos de qualidade da Natec. Executar montagens mecânicas e hidráulicas — cilindros, unidades hidráulicas, acionamentos, caixas de rolamento. Diagnosticar falhas em sistemas hidráulicos de circuito aberto e fechado. Ajustar e calibrar bombas de pistão de vazão variável e válvulas proporcionais. Verificar aspectos elétricos básicos associados a válvulas e HPUs. Elaborar relatórios de campo, RDOs e registros de manutenção. Reportar à engenharia e à liderança da Natec o andamento das frentes de trabalho e os desvios técnicos identificados. Preparar-se e deslocar-se para embarques e trabalhos embarcados conforme a demanda operacional. title: Dressing and Signage Design Manager
description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department: Technical & Infrastructure Location: Brazil THE POSITION The Dressing and Signage Design Manager reports to the Senior Dressing and Signage Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing and Signage Design Manager will be responsible for the overall management of the design workflow across the Dressing and Signage Project. The role is not principally a designer role, although the ability to design and artwork would be beneficial, the role will be to manage the workload of in-house and freelance design and artworking teams, and the workload for supplier-based artworking teams. The role will also be responsible for the sign-off of all event dressing and signage artworks prior to them entering the production phase. The successful candidate will work with the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Dressing and Signage appointed suppliers to develop a robust sign off procedure for the full product design, artwork and production processes using a combination of existing content management systems and in some cases custom solutions. They will be required to develop a comprehensive understanding of the brand for both tournaments and knowledge on how this can be translated successfully into elements suitable for dressing and signage. The role will be responsible for the design of all Dressing and Signage at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ including but not exclusive to the following workstream assets: Stadium Dressing Stadium Wayfinding Non-competition Venue Dressing Non-competition Venue Wayfinding Functional Area Signage and commodities Kit of Parts dressing Venue Concessions Fleet Buses The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA’s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES To manage the design and artwork of all printed and digital materials required for the Dressing and Signage and function. To manage the creation of any mock-ups or visualisations that are required for the Dressing and Signage Function. To manage a network of in-house freelance designers and the workload for appointed supplier based design teams. To work with suppliers to create templates for all artworks, with all production considerations catered for such as required bleed etc. To work with other functional areas to create template visualisations of spaces across official sites. To be the initial and primary member of the artwork sign of team ensuring all artworks meet the design guidelines and principles for the respective competitions. Develop and manage a robust design and artworking process with the Dressing and Signage appointed suppliers, maximizing use of their content management systems where possible. Acting as the focal point for all Dressing and Signage design and artwork related queries and inputting into team meetings and reporting where necessary. Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. YOUR PROFILE Strong experience in a Design management role in a fast paced environment, ideally with tangible experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. An understanding of the technical aspects of print and production on dressing and signage projects advantageous (i.e. print/production methods, materials and the end purpose of designed assets). Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events or projects. Experience in the development and integration of Design Processes using content management systems. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organisations and departments. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista Tributário Sênior
description: Contexte et environnement Política Tributária da empresa focada na previsibilidade (segurança jurídica) e sustentabilidade de longo prazo, comprometida com o pagamento justo de tributos em conformidade com a legislação aplicável; Contexte et environnement Política Tributária da empresa focada na previsibilidade (segurança jurídica) e sustentabilidade de longo prazo, comprometida com o pagamento justo de tributos em conformidade com a legislação aplicável; Atualizações do ERP (nova versão de transações e relatórios); Ambiente fiscal complexo, oneroso e instável, especialmente diante das mudanças trazidas pela Reforma Tributária. Activités Principais Atividades Apoiar o Gerente Tributário e o Coordenador Tributário em todas as questões fiscais, fornecendo análises técnicas e garantindo a conformidade com a legislação tributária aplicável; Elaborar os cálculos de Imposto de Renda da Pessoa Jurídica (IRPJ) e Contribuição Social sobre o Lucro Líquido (CSLL), incluindo Preços de Transferência (Transfer Pricing), regras de Subcapitalização (Thin Capitalization), Pilar 2 (Pilar 2), ganhos e perdas cambiais realizados, incentivos fiscais e outros temas relacionados aos tributos diretos; Elaborar os cálculos de Participações Governamentais (Government Take), incluindo Royalties e Participação Especial; Revisar o tratamento tributário de transações internacionais, incluindo impostos retidos na fonte, serviços importados, aplicação de tratados para evitar a dupla tributação e demais aspectos de tributação internacional; Revisar a tributação de retenções na fonte em operações domésticas, garantindo o correto tratamento fiscal e a conformidade com a legislação vigente; Avaliar e estimar os impactos tributários de projetos, transações e iniciativas de negócios da companhia; Preparar, revisar e submeter, dentro dos prazos, declarações fiscais, obrigações acessórias e demais documentos tributários à Receita Federal do Brasil; Realizar conciliações de contas tributárias; Apoiar a manutenção e o aprimoramento das configurações fiscais no SAP e Mastersaf, de forma a atender às necessidades da área de Tributos Diretos; Apoiar o Coordenador Tributário em auditorias, fiscalizações e questionamentos conduzidos pela Receita Federal do Brasil e pela ANP (Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis); Monitorar alterações na legislação tributária, regulamentações e jurisprudências, avaliando seus potenciais impactos nos cálculos, reportes e processos de compliance tributário da empresa. Responsabilidades Garantir a entrega tempestiva de informações precisas, completas e atualizadas ao Coordenador Tributário e ao Gerente Tributário para suportar os cálculos e reportes de Imposto de Renda Corporativo e Participações Governamentais; Demonstrar elevada atenção aos detalhes, pensamento crítico e postura proativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e mitigação de potenciais problemas; Identificar riscos tributários, questões de compliance e desafios operacionais, reportando prontamente assuntos relevantes ao Coordenador Tributário e propondo medidas adequadas de mitigação; Interagir com as áreas de Finanças, Comercial, Operações e demais funções de negócio para obter, validar e analisar informações necessárias às atividades de cálculo tributário, reporte e conformidade fiscal, incluindo PIS/COFINS e Participações Governamentais; Colaborar com assessores tributários externos, auditores e consultores, fornecendo informações técnicas, documentação de suporte e esclarecimentos relacionados a cálculos de tributos diretos, obrigações fiscais e assuntos de conformidade tributária. Profil du candidat Graduação em Ciências Contábeis ou Direito (preferencialmente); Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência na área tributária (experiência em empresas Big Four e/ou no segmento de Óleo & Gás é altamente desejável); Bons conhecimentos de sistemas tributários e financeiros (Mastersaf ou sistemas fiscais similares) e SAP; Informations supplémentaires TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: About Us At Félix, we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. We leverage cutting‑edge technology like AI, blockchain, and stablecoins to make cross‑border payments faster, more affordable, and more accessible than ever before. We are a hyper‑growth Series B company, backed by over $100 million in funding from top‑tier global investors, including QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, and General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. We are a group of extremely talented and dedicated high‑performers, united by our shared obsession with a single goal: empowering our customers. We are all owners of Félix, driven by a bias for action and a true experimentation spirit to get shit done with urgency and focus. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today. About The Role As a Product Operations Specialist focused on Fraud Operations Processes, you will not just execute risk policies—you will be the architect of how our fraud operations scale. In a hyper‑growth fintech environment moving millions of dollars over WhatsApp, efficiency, speed, and accuracy are paramount. Your mission is to own, audit, and optimize our entire Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) library, bridging the gap between risk management, product capability, and operational execution. You will map out, fix and scale complex workflows, identify automation opportunities alongside Engineering and Product, and package high‑volume processes so they are ready to be seamlessly executed and ready to stop fraud while ensuring the legitimate user experience. Your ultimate goal is to build bulletproof, invisible guardrails that mitigate fraud while ensuring a frictionless user journey for legitimate customers recovering from false declines. Responsibilities SOP Architecture & Process Scalability: Maintain, continuously improve, and own the single source of truth for all live fraud operational processes. Standardize and document high‑volume workflows into clear, repeatable, step‑by‑step processes that can be executed consistently by any team member with minimal ramp‑up or oversight. Governance & Audit Cadence: Design and execute internal monitoring mechanisms, dashboards, and spot‑checks for core processes to ensure compliance, maintain high quality, and significantly improve user journey. Process Metrics & KPIs: Define, track, and optimize key health metrics for fraud workflows, including process adherence, operational throughput, and process quality. Automation & Tooling Improvement: Identify systemic operational bottlenecks, build data‑driven business cases for automation, and partner directly with Product Ops and Engineering to implement tools that eliminate manual overhead. Change Control & Strategic Alignment: Own versioning, sign‑off, and cross‑functional communication whenever a process evolves. Partner closely with Workforce Management (WFM), Quality and Training to ensure updates are instantly reflected in capacity models and training calibrations. User Experience Safeguarding: Ensure that while minimizing fraud risk, the user recovery journey is seamless, minimizing friction when legitimate users face false declines. Requirements Fraud/Payments Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of financial fraud risk vectors and known patterns. SOP & Process Engineering: Proven track record of mapping, documenting, and scaling complex operational workflows within high‑growth fintechs or tech environments. Automation & Outsourcing Mindset: Experience prepping operational processes for automation or external vendors, with a sharp eye for separating high‑judgment tasks from transactional ones. Data Fluency: Strong hands‑on experience querying data (SQL, BigQuery, Omni, or similar) to extract process metrics, build operational dashboards, and back up business cases with hard numbers. Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills to align cross‑functional teams including Customer Operations, WFM, Product, Quality Assurance, and multiple stakeholders. Autonomy under Ambiguity: A true "owner" mentality with a strong bias for action, capable of navigating and creating structure out of unstructured startup environments. Language Proficiency: Professional fluency and advanced communication skills in English. These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. title: Motociclista - Zona Sul- RJ
description: Somos o vizinho especialista em produtos frescos e naturais, com qualidade impecável e uma experiência que faz o cliente se sentir em casa. Nossa alma é de feirante: gostamos de conversar, sorrir e oferecer aquele conforto emocional das feiras livres da infância, com um atendimento próximo, humano e cheio de alegria. Todos os dias acordamos com um único objetivo: promover uma vida mais natural – em todos os sentidos. Se você também acredita nesse propósito, vem com a gente! Organizar as compras na moto de acordo com a programação, manuseando as mercadorias com cuidado para não sofrer avaria, e garantir a correta entrega dos produtos. Fazer as entregas, conforme orientação do Fiscal de Caixa, observando as regras de trânsito e normas de segurança, zelando pela própria segurança e de terceiros. Acompanhar a quilometragem percorrida e relatar qualquer anormalidade para controle de manutenção preventiva e de custo da moto. Auxiliar na descarga e organização das mercadorias, respeitando as regras de empilhamento e organização. Ajudar o cliente com informações, sempre que solicitado, garantindo o bom atendimento. Atender solicitações dos clientes, desde que não ofereça prejuízo ao negócio ou infrinja procedimentos internos, oferecendo um nível de serviço diferenciado. Zelar pela segurança e bom uso dos equipamentos, manter o ambiente de trabalho e instrumentos limpos e organizados, cuidar da higiene pessoal e uniforme, de acordo com a legislação e normas vigentes. Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade do negócio e a critério do Gestor. INCLUSÃO E DIVERSIDADE Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência. Valorizamos a diversidade e estamos de braços abertos para todos os talentos, independentemente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual. Convênio farmácia Plano de saúde Alimentação no local Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil. Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável. Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 56 lojas espalhadas por 3 estados (RJ, SP e MG). Nossas lojas recebem cerca de meio milhão de clientes todos os meses. Com operações no modelo omnichannel, as compras pode serem realizadas também pelo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces parceiros, atendendo consumidores nas regiões onde estão presentes em até três horas. Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos todos os meses, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas. O Hortifruti Natural da Terra é referência em frutas, legumes, verduras e outros alimentos frescos. Unimos a relação de confiança e proximidade com os produtores ao bom atendimento e produtos de qualidade. Não somos um supermercado, nem feira. Mas o melhor dos dois! Nossa Missão: Promover uma vida mais natural, nos tornando referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil. Nossos Valores são: Jogo aberto e íntegro Foco em resultado com qualidade Trabalho em equipe compartilhando o sucesso Excelência no Atendimento Jeito simples e alegre de ser Atitude Responsável Atuamos com profissionalismo, amor e um sorriso estampado no rosto, esse é nosso jeito de ser. Somos mais do que um time, somos uma família! Queremos promover a diversidade em todos os sentidos e todas as equipes. Por isso, queremos o seu olhar também para torná-lo cada vez mais seguro, acolhedor, criativo e inclusivo. Todas as nossas vagas também são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, e toda a diversidade em relação a raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais é importante e será muito bem-vinda. __ #J-18808-Ljbffr
